issue_context.title: Support TiFlash replica in keyspace mode
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
Currently, TiDB is not allowed to create TiFlash replica while it's in API V2: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/41167. TiFlash has already supported keyspace mode by https://github.com/pingcap/tiflash/pull/6816. We should remove the restriction for TiDB.

**Describe the feature you'd like:**
API V2 users could create TiFlash replicas.

**Describe alternatives you've considered:**
None

**Teachability, Documentation, Adoption, Migration Strategy:**
Related issue:
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/40425
